registry.title: quote imbalance is big enough to pay a taker round trip
registry.statement: the book's own imbalance (bid vs ask size at the touch, and its change) predicts the mid move over 1/5/60 s by more than the venue's round-trip taker cost, so the prediction is executable by a taker order
registry.falsified_if: the best measured mean gross move at any horizon is below the measured round-trip cost for that asset
registry.data_requirement: forward book_ticker at quote level (no historical substitute exists)
registry.reason: best measured cell perp/SOLUSDT h=60s gross 1.582703 bps vs 24.0731 bps barrier — gross 1.5827 bps is below the measured round trip 24.0731 bps (cells: {'COST_KILLED': 30})

registry.title: the fee schedule is the binding constraint, not the signal
registry.statement: the same measured gross move clears the barrier at a venue whose taker fee is lower, so the venue choice (not the model) is what blocks the edge
registry.falsified_if: no compared venue brings the round-trip cost at or below the measured gross move, including the venue with the lowest researched taker fee
registry.data_requirement: measured spread + the published fee schedules already registered
registry.decided_at: F2 (cost survival) with V3 venue scenarios
registry.note: a venue change is a governance decision; this measures, it does not adopt
registry.reason: the cheapest registered schedule (MEXC_SPOT_TAKER at 12.9866 bps) still exceeds the best measured gross (1.582703 bps): the fee schedule is not the only constraint

registry.title: the measured book can absorb our order size inside the barrier
registry.statement: at the registered order size the captured book offers enough notional inside the barrier-implied impact, so the modelled cost is not a fiction
registry.falsified_if: the notional available within the barrier-implied price band is below the runtime's minimum order notional
registry.data_requirement: forward depth snapshots (10 levels) per symbol and market
registry.reason: spot depth snapshots are rare in this capture, so a spot capacity claim rests on a small number of observations and is reported as such

registry.title: open interest with price is exploitable on a slower clock
registry.statement: the quadrant 'price down and open interest up' carries a positive forward move large enough to pay the round trip at a 5-minute horizon
registry.falsified_if: no quadrant cell reaches a positive mean gross move at or above the round-trip cost, or the sample is below the registered floor
registry.data_requirement: forward open interest + mid at 5-minute resolution
registry.decided_at: F1/F2 with an explicit sample floor
registry.reason: PRICE_DOWN_OI_UP n=14 mean=-8.015351 bps against a barrier of 23.1512 bps

registry.title: three executed trades a day is reachable by a positive structure
registry.statement: a structure whose expected move clears the barrier occurs at least three times a day across the aggregate universe, so the ACTIVE objective is a strategy question and not an arithmetic impossibility
registry.falsified_if: the measured count of barrier-clearing opportunities per day is below the registered 3.0, no trade being forced to reach it
registry.data_requirement: the same quote panel, counted without a performance filter
registry.reason: the tape clears the barrier at h=60s at 144.061 long-only opportunities/day (upper bound, long-only, extrapolated from 1.999-4.155 h of capture), so the ACTIVE frequency target is not what blocks the book at those horizons

registry.title: a taker entry pays no more than the measured spread and impact
registry.statement: the price a taker order actually pays, measured against the mid at the decision instant, matches the modelled spread plus impact component, so the cost model is not systematically optimistic
registry.falsified_if: the measured execution shortfall exceeds the modelled spread+impact component by more than the published tolerance
registry.data_requirement: forward tape (agg_trade with aggressor side) + book_ticker
registry.decided_at: measured, then compared to the model; not an admission filter
registry.reason: median measured taker shortfall 0.0187 bps against the modelled spread+impact components

registry.title: negative control: the pipeline does not manufacture an edge
registry.statement: the identical pipeline, fed a feature destroyed by a deterministic shuffle inside each day, produces no cost-surviving edge
registry.falsified_if: the negative control reaches the positive classification, which would invalidate every other result in this package
registry.decided_at: must end COST_KILLED or NO_GROSS_EDGE or NO_INFORMATION
registry.note: FALSE_SUCCESS guard: a positive control here stops the package
